title: TTL to MOS driver

sources.document: TI The Interface Circuits Data Book for Design Engineers, 2nd ed. 1981, SN75322 dual positive-AND TTL-to-MOS driver (bulletin DL-S 7712336, May 1976, rev. Apr 1977)

pins.name: 1Y
pins.text: MOS-level output, pulled up through the external p-n-p transistor

pins.name: 1XC
pins.text: connection to the collector of the external p-n-p transistor for driver 1

pins.name: 1XB
pins.text: connection to the base of the external p-n-p transistor for driver 1

pins.name: 2XC
pins.text: collector connection of the external p-n-p for driver 2

pins.name: 2XB
pins.text: base connection of the external p-n-p for driver 2

functions.text: Datasheet positive logic Y = AE. Needs an external p-n-p (TIS149, A5T4260 or A5T4261) per driver on XB/XC.

electrical.notes: VCC1 4.75-5.25 V, VCC2 4.75-15 V (nom 12), TA 0-70 C, load capacitance min 200 pF (recommended). VOH min VCC2-1.1 V at -10 mA, VCC2-0.5 at -400 uA, VCC2-0.4 at -200 uA; VOL max 0.5 V at IOL 10 mA (VCC2 11.4 V). Inputs VIH 2 V, VIL 0.8 V; IIL A -1.6 mA, E -3.2 mA. Output goes to high impedance if the 5 V supply is lost (forced low with an external pull-down). outputMaxVoltageV is the VCC2 maximum.

timing.conditions: VCC1 5 V, VCC2 12 V, TA 25 C, CL 300 pF, external TIS149 p-n-p
VCC1 5 V, VCC2 12 V, TA 25 C, CL 300 pF, external TIS149 p-n-p

timingLimits.text: tDLH 16 typ / 21 max ns, tDHL 18 typ / 24 max ns
tTLH 11 typ / 17 max ns, tTHL 13 typ / 20 max ns, CL 300 pF

unknown: Recommended IOL/IOH are not given; only VOH/VOL test points (in notes), so the current fields are null.
